Usage: astryx experimental icon use [options] <set>

[experimental] Choose the project's icon set

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  experimental.iconSet is written, or already names the set
  1  the set is not installed, two packages ship it, the config cannot be updated (not a static object literal, or it spreads another object, which you then edit by hand), or the config is protected (a symbolic link, or marked generated, vendored, or ignored: `ERR_CODEMOD_PROTECTED`, naming the declaration)

Examples:
  # Use a set
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon use outline
  # Name its package
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon use @acme/icons/outline

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/experimental-icon-use
